envelope.description: Prove real git runs the hooks, document the feature and run the affected suites

body.title: Prove real git runs the hooks, document the feature and run the affected suites
body.summary: Add the integration cases where a real git pull and a real git pull --rebase in a temporary repository run the installed hooks and exit 0 even when the entry or the daemon is missing, document the feature and its limits in docs/plans/team-workflow.md, then run the affected suites once in the foreground by area and record the comparison with a clean base checkout.
acceptanceChecks: A real pull and a real pull --rebase run the post-merge and post-rewrite hooks and git exits 0 with the entry missing and with the daemon down
docs/plans/team-workflow.md states the feature, the terminal-push gap, the hook managers that regenerate files and the explicit refresh
The tracker, daemon method, settings and handler-runtime suites pass or fail identically to a clean base checkout, recorded in a sweep file

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/git-hooks-real-git.test.ts: a real git pull and a real git pull --rebase run the installed hooks and git exits 0 even when the hook entry is missing or the daemon is down
